pool.text: The Arab geographer al-Idrisi mentions Mombasa as a prosperous trading town.
Vasco da Gama became the first known European to visit Mombasa.
The sultanate became independent from Kilwa Kisiwani and was renamed.
The Portuguese encountered the city under Francisco de Almeida.
The Mandhry Mosque was built with a minaret containing an ogee arch.
An Ottoman military expedition successfully captured Mombasa and other coastal cities.
The Portuguese took over Mombasa for a third time.
Kalonga Mzura made an alliance with the Portuguese to defeat the Zimba.
Dom Jeronimo slaughtered the Portuguese garrison and defeated a relief force.
The Aga Khan Hospital was established as an 82-bed facility.
The Mombasa tusks were originally constructed to commemorate a royal visit.
A ferry serving the Mtongwe route sank in a major accident.
The ferry became the target of the Likoni Riots.
One-Way Ticket to Mombasa was released as a Finnish film.
Mombasa was featured in the movie Inception.
Public health services were devolved to Kenya's county governments.
The Mombasa Terminus station was completed to link the city to Nairobi.
Mombasa County Governor Hassan Joho issued a painting directive for Old Town.
Jason Dunford released music under the name Samaki Mkuu.
The county government launched a programme branded Mombasa Care.
